# Salmon Fishing Spoon

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model for a salmon fishing spoon featuring both a twist and a curve, inspired by designs like the cop car and cookies-and-cream spoons. It features an oval-shaped body designed to mimic baitfish movement and attract strikes.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
